name: Shanta–Rishyasringa Temple, Baga
location: Baga / Banjar valley, Kullu, Himachal Pradesh
summary: Kullu’s Baga valley shrine where Shanta and Rishyasringa are worshipped together.
famousFor: Himalayan seat of Rama’s sister Shanta with Rishyasringa
mythology: Himachali memory places Shanta and Rishyasringa in the Banjar hills. Here the couple is not a footnote — Mata Shanta stands beside the sage whose yajna blessed Dasharatha with sons, linking Himalayan devotion to Ayodhya’s story.
